evals.name: capture-agentic-opinion
evals.prompt: Estoy leyendo 114 y esta es mi opinión: siento que lo de Terminal OSF-053 hace que el monolito se sienta parte de una red más grande. Toma nota de eso.
evals.expected_output: Captures the user's opinion as human-owned research, links the relevant Episode/Entity notes when they exist, updates active reading state, and does not present the opinion as canon.

assertions.name: preserves-personal-interpretation
assertions.description: The note preserves the user's interpretation and does not upgrade it to confirmed canon.

assertions.name: distinguishes-episode-and-entity
assertions.description: Episode references and Entity references are not collapsed into one concept.

evals.name: update-reading-properties
evals.prompt: Ya terminé 090. Ponelo como favorito y le doy 9/10.
evals.expected_output: Updates the Episode human-owned properties to complete, favorite true, rating 9, and refreshes last_read without touching generated source content.

assertions.name: updates-only-human-owned-state
assertions.description: Only the intended human-owned Episode state is modified.

evals.name: reject-lore-match
evals.prompt: Ese match que sugeriste no cuadra. No es el mismo Monolith. Guardá que lo rechazo para que no vuelva a salir.
evals.expected_output: Persists a rejected relationship decision using the implemented knowledge schema, or records the decision as a personal research note if that schema does not exist yet.

assertions.name: does-not-invent-schema
assertions.description: The skill does not fabricate a knowledge-layer storage format when the project has not implemented one.
